messages:
Claire (CS): quick hit  post-onboard notes for Verdance private/VPC: SOC asked for 180d retention, KMS cross-account grant, and we saw 403s on bursts. who can pick these up?
Vera (Verdance PM): thanks Claire. bucket is verdance-priv-logs, SSE-KMS using key alias/verdance-key. 403s happened during a 2k req burst at 14:03 UTC. SOC needs the 180d retention before cert.
Omar (Solutions): ok. two things: 1) collector concurrency is high, will add smoothing, 2) need to check S3 bucket policy + KMS key policy. provide me bucket policy and we'll test.
Vera (Verdance PM): posting bucket policy later. team prefers lifecycle -> transition to IA at 30d and expire at 180d.
Jun (Security Eng): KMS: recommend role in Verdance account arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/verdance-priv-ingest that Redwood assumes. key policy snippet to allow kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey with SourceAccount condition. I'll put a small doc.
Claire (CS): actions: Omar tweaks collector concurrency and validate (due: +1 business day). Jun to share KMS policy snippet and rotation cadence note (due: Wed). Vera to apply lifecycle change and confirm (due: Wed afternoon). I'll track and update health.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: collector-concurrency-smooth (run id: r-2244).
Omar (Solutions): queued change applied to staging, running 20m soak then smoke test. will report.
Jun (Security Eng): audit blurb (one-paragraph): "Verdance private deployment forwards VPC flow and app logs to the customer-managed S3 bucket 'verdance-priv-logs' with retention set to 180 days via lifecycle policy and transition to infrequent access after 30 days. Cryptographic keys are customer-managed KMS keys (alias/verdance-key); Redwood assumes a least-privileged cross-account ingest role for decryption. Key rotation is performed annually and emergency rekey/rollback steps are documented in the private deploy runbook."
Vera (Verdance PM): that works for SOC. i'll apply lifecycle today and confirm once done. thanks all.
Claire (CS): marking account health as 'amber' pending lifecycle + KMS snippet. will reopen if issues after soak.
